name: cOPDSzlib
short_desc: OPDS catalog for Readest: search and download from libgen, with accounts, recommendation lists and Legado book sources.
author: gxiang314
description: An OPDS 1.2 catalog that lets Readest and other OPDS readers search Library Genesis and download books directly. Searches expand Traditional/Simplified Chinese and partial titles and group each book's formats into one entry. The root catalog offers Douban, Open Library and Taiwan bestseller lists, and your own Legado book sources (with covers). The web UI has a download queue, user and app-password management, and an administrator page for environment settings.

form_fields.label: Username
form_fields.hint: Name of the first administrator (web UI, OPDS feed and API). Its password is reset to the one below at every start, so it is also the recovery path.

form_fields.label: Password
form_fields.hint: Administrator password; Readest asks for it when adding the catalog. Create further users in the web UI and give e-readers app passwords instead.

form_fields.label: Master key
form_fields.hint: Generated once; encrypts secret settings stored in the database. Do not change it, or those settings become unreadable.

form_fields.label: Public base URL
form_fields.hint: Only when exposed on a domain over HTTPS, e.g. https://opds.example.com — feed links then use it. Leave empty for LAN use.

form_fields.label: Recommendation sources
form_fields.hint: Comma-separated: douban, openlibrary, readmoo, kingstone, taaze. Empty means all; off disables them.
